entries.en: We've got a pretty modern case in.[n]Basically it's some kid doing a[n]lot of illegal downloads.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Sounds like the tip came from his[n]friend. Apparently they're both in[n]elementary school.

entries.speaker: Mishima

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Hey, there's no age restrictions[n]when it comes to crime, y'know.

entries.speaker: Mishima

entries.speaker: Mishima

entries.speaker: Mishima
